import ctypes
import os

def assert_test():
    # Load the required libraries in the correct order
    libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"
    libgsl_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so"

    # Load libgslcblas.so globally
    ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)

    # Load libgsl.so
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

    # Define the return type of gsl_rng_env_setup

    # Call gsl_rng_env_setup
    rng_type_ptr = gsl.gsl_rng_env_setup()

    # Assert that the returned pointer is not NULL
    assert rng_type_ptr is not None, "gsl_rng_env_setup returned a NULL pointer."

    # Print success message
    print("gsl_rng_env_setup executed successfully and returned a valid pointer.")
